newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ share market closes firmer but volume light.
newsitem.headline: NZ share market closes firmer but volume light.

text.p: * Good lines in Carter Holt Harvey and Lion Nathan
The New Zealand share market closed in positive territory on Friday thanks mainly to Telecom and Fletcher Paper.

The top 40 index ended 5.72 up at 2350.42. Volume was light at $21.8 million but was boosted by a couple of lines of 1.2 million each in Lion and Carter Holt Harvey and a line of 2.3 million Direct Capital.
Brokers said selling in Lion probably came from the Capital Group of Companies which has recently reduced its stake.

Some end of year jockeying in stocks is expected next week but the next main event is likely to be December quarter inflation data due on January 17 which will determine if interest rates can go lower yet.
Newspaper stocks were in demand with Wilson & Horton up 15 cents to $11.75 and Independent Newspapers up 10 to $7.10.
